value.summary: The change re-aliases `oh` from `openhuman_core::openhuman` to the crate root `openhuman_core`, so all `oh::` references (including `oh::memory` on the following line) now resolve one level higher. Whether `openhuman_core` exposes `memory` and its types at the crate root cannot be verified from this diff alone; if it does, the change is safe to merge.
